T: The stakes are high. So is the buffet.
D: In his first mission as 007, Bond takes on a banker to terrorists at a high-stakes poker game.
P: Serve the drinks when Bond invents the Vesper at the poker table.
S: Fig prosciutto, olive and cheddar picks
Prosciutto wrapped figs, warm orange olives and cheddar shards on toothpicks
Ripe figs halved and wrapped in prosciutto, warm olives marinated with orange peel and fennel seed, and shards of aged cheddar, all on toothpicks so nobody touches the cards with greasy fingers.
Shaved fennel, orange segments and toasted hazelnuts on butter lettuce, Dijon dressing
Butter lettuce leaves, fennel shaved paper thin, orange segments cut free of pith and hazelnuts toasted at 170C for 8 minutes, dressed at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

Crisp golden fritters of chopped prawn and crab with capsicum, celery, spring onion and scotch bonnet, with a zingy lime and chilli aioli. Chop 250g peeled green prawns and mix with 150g crab meat, half a finely diced red capsicum, a celery stick, 2 spring onions and a little chopped scotch bonnet. Whisk in 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 125ml milk to a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayo with lime zest and juice, a crushed garlic clove and chilli sauce.
M: Garlic rosemary lamb chops grilled hot, roasted red peppers, garlic yogurt
Lamb shoulder chops marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled hot until charred and pink inside, with roasted capsicum and a garlic yoghurt sauce.

Carnaroli cooked slowly in fish stock with white wine, loaded with prawns, mussels and squid, finished with butter and a sharp lemon, garlic and parsley gremolata. Soften 2 chopped shallots and 2 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp olive oil, add 350g carnaroli and toast 1 minute. Add 125ml white wine, then 1.2L hot fish stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 16 minutes. Add 300g peeled green prawns, 500g mussels and 200g sliced squid, cover and cook 3 minutes until the mussels open. Stir in 30g butter. Chop parsley, lemon zest and a garlic clove for gremolata and scatter over.
W: Warm chocolate cakes with a molten center
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked into eggs and sugar beaten pale, a little flour folded in, baked in buttered and cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes, turned out so the centre runs.
K: The Vesper gin and vodka martini
Gin, vodka and white vermouth shaken ice cold, with a long lemon peel
60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml aromatised white wine shaken very cold, strained into a deep coupe, a long strip of lemon peel.

dishes.n: Fig prosciutto, olive and cheddar picks

steps.text: Wrap each fig half in a piece of prosciutto.
Warm the olives in a small pan with the orange peel and fennel seeds until fragrant.
Break the cheddar into shards and push everything onto toothpicks so nobody gets greasy fingers on the cards.
Toast the hazelnuts at 170C for 8 minutes, cool and roughly chop.
Shave the fennel paper thin and cut the oranges into segments.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and oil into a dressing. Toss the lettuce, fennel, orange and nuts together with the dressing at the last second.
Crush 4 of the garlic cloves and mix with the chopped rosemary, lemon juice and zest and the oil. Rub over the lamb.
Cover and marinate in the fridge overnight.
Roast the capsicums at 220C until blistered, then peel and slice.
Grill the lamb hot until charred outside and pink inside.
Crush the last garlic clove into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt. Serve with the lamb and capsicums.

dishes.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: butter, plus extra for the moulds

steps.text: Butter 4 moulds and dust with cocoa. Melt the chocolate and butter together and let it cool a little.
Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until pale, then combine with the chocolate and fold in the flour.
Divide between the moulds and bake at 220C for 9 minutes.
Turn out straight away so the centres run.

dishes.n: The Vesper gin and vodka martini

steps.text: Shake the gin, vodka and vermouth hard with ice until very cold, in batches if needed.
Strain into deep chilled coupes and add a long strip of lemon peel to each.

s.n: Fig prosciutto, olive and cheddar picks
s.note: Prosciutto wrapped figs, warm orange olives and cheddar shards on toothpicks
s.how: Wrap 6 halved figs in 100g prosciutto. Warm 200g olives with orange peel and a pinch of fennel seeds. Break 150g aged cheddar into shards. Put everything on toothpicks so no one gets greasy fingers on the cards.

s.note: Shaved fennel, orange segments and toasted hazelnuts on butter lettuce, Dijon dressing
s.how: Toast 60g hazelnuts at 170C for 8 minutes and chop. Shave a fennel bulb paper thin and segment 2 oranges. Toss with butter lettuce leaves and dress at the last second with Dijon, white wine vinegar and olive oil.

m.note: Garlic rosemary lamb chops grilled hot, roasted red peppers, garlic yogurt
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg lamb shoulder chops overnight in 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill hot until charred and pink inside. Roast 3 red capsicums and slice. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a crushed garlic clove.

w.note: Warm chocolate cakes with a molten center
w.how: Melt 125g dark chocolate with 125g butter. Whisk 2 eggs and 2 yolks with 60g sugar until pale, combine and fold in 30g flour. Bake in 4 buttered, cocoa-dusted moulds at 220C for 9 minutes. Turn out so the centres run.

d.n: The Vesper gin and vodka martini
d.note: Gin, vodka and white vermouth shaken ice cold, with a long lemon peel
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml gin, 20ml vodka and 10ml white vermouth hard with ice until very cold. Strain into a deep chilled coupe and add a long strip of lemon peel. Makes four.
